notes.title: New Patch
notes.notes:
New Patch includes:

Fixed background render setting not working correctly

Mouse clicks no longer works through UI

Now background resizes with the game window

Added more Chroma Key presets

Also with that we have a Weekend Sale with -40%!  


You can always give us feedback in our discord server: link to Discord

notes.title: Virtual Keyboard Update!
notes.notes:
In this big update we focused on adding more usage of this Game/Tool, we added Virtual Keyboard support!


Now you don't need to have physical keyboard, you can use any virtual keyboard from your collection and write with it!


New Features and Changes:

Virtual keyboard

Support for mouse

Option to highlight pressed keys

There is now option to turn off/on camera renderer while game is not focused

New background color - Chroma key

Some keyboards rarities were changed



As this update is pretty hard to maintain and test, if you will have any issues, please leave the feedback in our Discord server: link

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
In this update we improved some small issues and now the game would feel better:

Added new icons to buttons

Keyboards will drop with 100% instead of 13.789999999999f% chance each 30 minutes now

AFK Clicks are now added to statistics and total score

Added Discord button in the menu 

 You can always leave your feedback on our discord server: link to Discord

notes.title: Major update is out - CRAFTING!
notes.notes:
In the newest update we added crafting and disassembling of keyboards.

You can craft new keyboards from 10 details any quality, that you can obtain by destroying old keyboards you don't want to keep with you.

We also greatly reduced chances of getting rare keyboards from time drops, and some keyboards can't even be dropped anymore, only crafted!

Update includes:

 Crafting


 Disassembling


 Minor fixes and improvements



You can always give us feedback in our discord server: link to Discord

notes.title: New update is out!
notes.notes:

Remember that you can provide us feedback and ask question regardless of what current chances are in our discord server: link to Discord
